admin.nav.label: Admin
admin.reports.title: Problem reports
admin.reports.about: Reports people chose to send from their homes. They hold no names, video titles, file names or addresses, and are deleted after 90 days.
admin.reports.screenshot: The screenshot sent with the report
admin.reports.replyNote: The home's admin sees it in the report, and the person who sent it in My reports.
admin.reports.timeline: What happened, from the app and the home
admin.reports.crashFrames: The crashed thread, the top frame first. The app's own frames are in bold.
admin.reports.noSymbols: No symbols for {binaries}. Upload the release's dSYMs with maktaba-symbols to read these frames as functions and lines.
admin.reports.noMapping: No R8 mapping for {app} {version}. Upload the release's mapping.txt with maktaba-symbols to read these frames as classes, methods and lines.
admin.reports.symbols.mapping: Read with the release's R8 mapping: the obfuscated frame follows each name.
admin.reports.symbols.source: This app is not obfuscated: its frames are its code's own names and lines.
admin.reports.symbols.native: Read with the tables of the app's own native libraries: system libraries' frames are as they came.
admin.reports.noNativeSymbols: No native symbols for {libraries}. Upload the release's unstripped libraries with maktaba-symbols to read these frames as functions and lines; a dependency's prebuilt library may have none.
admin.reports.noFrames: Only the reason was kept, with no frames: a native crash before Android 12, or a tombstone that could not be read.

admin.overview.title: Operator console
admin.accounts.title: Accounts
admin.account.title: Account
admin.account.suspendBody: Every session is signed out and the account cannot sign in until it is unsuspended.
admin.account.unsuspendBody: The account can sign in again.
admin.account.setPlanBody: Sets the plan by hand, for use while payments are not set up. The change is audited.
admin.servers.title: Servers
admin.abuse.title: Abuse
admin.abuse.subject: Subject
admin.abuse.expiresHint: Leave empty to block until unblocked.
admin.abuse.hoursInvalid: Enter a whole number of hours.
admin.audit.title: Audit log
admin.usage.title: Usage data
admin.usage.about: Anonymous data from homes whose admin turned on sharing, and from apps whose user did. Install ids are random and not linked to any account, server, person or address.
admin.usage.components: Components on (share of homes that report them)
admin.logs.title: The cloud's logs
admin.logs.about: Every node's lines, kept 14 days on the witness, searchable even while a node is down. A home is named only by its hash.
admin.errors.title: Errors
admin.errors.logs_unavailable: The cloud's log index (the witness) is not set up yet: only the homes' errors show.
admin.errors.logs_unreachable: The cloud's log index (the witness) did not answer.
admin.errors.homesAbout: From the homes that share anonymous usage data: no home, account or person is named.
admin.denied.title: Access denied
admin.denied.body: This page is for Maktaba Cloud service admins.
admin.symbols.title: Crash symbols
admin.symbols.about: The Apple apps' symbols from each release's dSYMs, the Android apps' R8 mappings, and their own native libraries' symbols (by build ID). A report's crash reads as functions and lines only for the binaries, releases and libraries listed here. They are uploaded with maktaba-symbols.

staff.mfa.failed: That code didn't work. Try again.
staff.mfa.required: This account needs two-step sign-in set up first. Ask the owner for an enrolment link.

staff.enroll.totp: Scan this code with your authenticator app

staff.session.capped: Your session ended after 8 hours. Sign in again.
staff.locked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for 30 minutes.
staff.ipNotAllowed: The console can't be used from this network.
staff.forbidden: Your staff account doesn't have this permission.

staff.mfa.recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up your account.
staff.sessions.signOutAllBody: Every session of your staff account ends, this one included.

staff.enroll.secret: Or type this key into the app:

error.password_breached: That password has appeared in a data breach. Choose another.

admin.broadcast.title: Broadcast kill switch
admin.broadcast.unsigned: No broadcast signing key is set: changes are saved but no signed list reaches the edge or homes.
admin.broadcast.added: Added. The edge stops it within a minute.
admin.broadcast.refHint.programme: The edge channel id the programme airs on.
admin.broadcast.liftBody: The broadcast may go back on air within a minute. Say why in the audit.
